title.zh: 在还没加载的会话里敲斜杠命令不再失败
title.en: Slash commands no longer fail in a session that has not loaded yet

summary.zh: 斜杠命令发出去的时候没有带上它属于哪个助手，服务端只好去找当前加载在内存里的会话记录来倒推。会话还没被加载时那里什么都没有，于是命令直接失败，弹出来的是一句「agentId required」，一个内部契约的断言原文，对你没有任何意义。现在命令自己带上会话的助手身份，服务端也改为以会话记录的归属为准，不再依赖它当下有没有被加载。
summary.en: A slash command was sent without saying which assistant it belonged to, so the server tried to work that out from whichever session record happened to be loaded in memory. In a session that had not loaded yet there was nothing there, so the command simply failed with an agentId-required message, the raw text of an internal contract assertion, which means nothing to you. The command now carries its session's assistant identity, and the server resolves ownership from the session's own record rather than from whether it happens to be loaded.

details.zh: 输入框里的助手提及菜单现在和斜杠命令读的是同一个身份来源，两者不会再各算各的。
details.en: The assistant-mention menu in the input box now reads the same identity as slash execution, so the two can no longer disagree.

sources.title: fix(chat): slash commands carry their session's agent identity
refactor(input): share the slash agent identity expression
refactor(server): resolve ws session identity in one place

title.zh: 侧边栏的恢复提示关掉之后就真的关掉了
title.en: Dismissing the sidebar recovery notice actually dismisses it

summary.zh: 数据降级后侧边栏会出现一条恢复提示。它有两个毛病叠在一起：关掉之后每次启动又会冒出来，等于关不掉；而关掉这个动作又会把整个提示位永久清空，于是更新提醒、壳阻塞提示这些本该显示的卡片也一起看不见了。现在关掉是对「这一组具体的降级」永久静默，只有出现新的降级才会再提示一次，而且只提示一次；提示位则是让出来给下一张卡片，而不是被清空。
summary.en: After a data degradation the sidebar shows a recovery notice. Two problems compounded: dismissing it did not stick, since it returned on every launch, and dismissing it permanently blanked the entire notice slot, so update prompts and shell-blocked cards that belonged there disappeared too. Dismissing now silences that exact set of degradations for good, with only a new degradation showing it again and only once; and the slot is yielded to the next card rather than emptied.

details.zh: 空列表状态下的文案也改成了跟当前语境相符的说法。
details.en: The empty-state copy was also reworded to match the context it actually appears in.

sources.title: fix(desktop): meta-recovery notice dismisses permanently per degradation set
fix(desktop): a dismissed recovery notice yields the slot instead of emptying it

title.zh: 新建独立会话不再改动上一个会话的记忆开关
title.en: Creating a detached session no longer rewrites the previous session's memory switch

summary.zh: 写入会话元信息的那段代码不接收「要写哪个会话」，而是去读当前焦点所在的会话，然后写在那儿。新建一个独立会话时，焦点还停在上一个会话上，于是新会话的记忆设置被写进了上一个会话，两边都不对。现在写入方必须被明确告知目标会话，不再从全局焦点指针猜。
summary.en: The code that writes session metadata was never told which session to write to; it read whichever session currently had focus and wrote there. When creating a detached session, focus was still on the previous one, so the new session's memory setting landed on the old session and both ended up wrong. The writer must now be told its target explicitly rather than inferring it from a global focus pointer.

details.zh: 所有创建路径都走同一个显式接口，包括路由、调度器和会话工具。
details.en: Every creation path goes through the same explicit interface, including routes, the scheduler and the session tool.

sources.title: fix(session): persistSessionMeta takes an explicit session path

title.zh: 崩溃日志和启动失败对话框同时记下外壳与内容两个版本号
title.en: The crash log and startup-failure dialog record both the shell and content versions

summary.zh: 应用的外壳和内容走的是两条独立的版本线，出问题时只知道其中一个，往往判断不出来是哪一侧的问题。崩溃日志的头部和启动失败时弹出的对话框现在两个都写上，报障时把这段贴出来就够了。
summary.en: The app's shell and its content follow two separate version lines, and knowing only one of them often makes it impossible to tell which side failed. The crash log header and the startup-failure dialog now record both, so pasting that section is enough when reporting a problem.

sources.title: fix(desktop): crash log carries both shell and content versions
test(desktop): pin the crash log version header contract

title.zh: 点击保存好的截图会在系统文件管理器里定位到它
title.en: Clicking a saved screenshot reveals it in the system file manager

summary.zh: 截图保存后会出现一条可点的结果提示。以前点它是在应用内打开这个文件或跳到工作区树，现在改为调起系统的文件管理器并选中那个文件（拿不到文件本身时退一步打开它所在的目录），方便你接着拖到别处去用。
summary.en: A saved screenshot leaves a clickable result notice. Clicking it used to open the file inside the app or jump to the workspace tree; it now opens the system file manager with the file selected, falling back to opening its containing directory, so you can drag it somewhere else from there.

details.zh: 这条提示同时补上了键盘可达性：可以用 Tab 移到它上面，再用回车或空格触发，不必非得用鼠标点。
details.en: The notice also became keyboard-reachable: you can Tab to it and trigger it with Enter or Space rather than having to click it.

sources.title: fix(input): reveal screenshot results in file manager

summary.zh: 这一版最大的新东西是工作区文件历史。工作区里的文本文件被改动时会自动留一份快照，在文件树上右键、或在预览里点历史按钮，就能翻到任意一版，看到一段「还原之后会变成什么样」的逐行 diff，确认了再写回；还原这个动作本身也会被记成一版，所以随时能再还原回来。它只收文本文件（单份上限 5MB），一分钟内的连续改动并成一条，保留 30 天、每个工作区最多占 500MB，node_modules、dist 这类目录和 lock、log 文件不收。模型这边接上了 Claude Opus 5 与 Sonnet 5，它们的 Max 思考档不再被降成 High；普通对话的默认输出上限从 32K 提到 64K，另外给出 128K 和 256K 两个显式选项。新会话的标题从此按你真正打的字来取——以前随消息一起注入的提醒和附件标记会把标题占满，没配摘要模型的人看到的就是一段标记文本截断成 30 个字，存量里这类标题会被清掉。切换到装不下当前对话的模型时不再自动压缩或截断历史，而是先问你要不要压缩。另外，工具集合变化不再弹出打断对话的刷新提示。
summary.en: The headline addition this release is workspace file history. Text files in your workspace are snapshotted automatically as you change them; right-click a file in the tree, or press the history button in the preview, and you can walk back to any version, read a line-by-line diff of what restoring would actually change, and write it back once you agree. The restore itself is recorded as a version too, so you can always restore back. It covers text files only (5MB each), merges consecutive edits within one minute into a single version, keeps 30 days and at most 500MB per workspace, and skips directories like node_modules and dist along with lock and log files. On the model side, Claude Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 are wired up and their Max thinking level is no longer downgraded to High; the default output ceiling for ordinary chat moves from 32K to 64K, with 128K and 256K added as explicit choices. New chats are now titled from what you actually typed: the reminders and attachment markers injected alongside your message used to fill the title, so anyone without a summarizer model configured saw marker text cut off at 30 characters, and existing titles like that are removed. Switching to a model that cannot hold the current conversation no longer compacts or truncates history behind your back; it asks you to compact first. And a changing tool set no longer interrupts the conversation with a refresh prompt.

title.zh: 工作区文件历史：自动快照、逐行 diff、确认后还原
title.en: Workspace file history: automatic snapshots, line diff, restore on confirm

summary.zh: 工作区里的文本文件每次被改动，都会自动留下一份带时间的快照，无论改动来自你自己、助手的工具调用，还是外部编辑器。打开历史弹窗后是三栏：左边是这个工作区所有留过历史的文件（删掉的文件单独一组，仍然翻得到），中间是选中文件的版本时间线，右边是逐行 diff 与还原按钮。还原走的是正常的文件写入通道，所以工作区树和已打开的编辑器会跟着刷新；还原动作本身也会被记成新的一版，因此每一次还原都是可撤销的。
summary.en: Every change to a text file in your workspace leaves a timestamped snapshot behind, whether the change came from you, from a tool call, or from an editor outside the app. The history dialog has three columns: on the left every file in this workspace that has history (deleted files grouped separately and still reachable), in the middle the version timeline for the selected file, on the right a line-by-line diff and the restore button. Restoring goes through the normal file-write path, so the workspace tree and any open editor refresh with it, and the restore itself is recorded as a new version, which makes every restore reversible.

details.zh: 两个入口，都只是同一个弹窗的调用方：文件树上右键某个文件，或在预览里点悬浮的历史按钮。只对本地工作区开放。
details.en: Two entry points, both opening the same dialog: right-click a file in the workspace tree, or press the floating history button in the preview. Local workspaces only.

details.zh: diff 的方向是「当前内容 → 选中的那一版」，读出来就是还原之后会发生什么：绿色的行是会被写回的内容，红色的行是会被替换掉的当前内容。当前内容读不到（文件已删除、或挂载在远端）时退回与上一版比对，再不行就展示那一版的全文，不拼一个看起来像 diff 的东西出来。
details.en: The diff reads from current content to the selected version, so what you see is what restoring would do: added lines are what gets written back, removed lines are the current content it replaces. When the current content cannot be read (the file is gone, or the mount is remote) it falls back to comparing against the previous version, and failing that shows the snapshot in full rather than fabricating a diff.

details.zh: 收录范围有意收窄：只存文本文件、单份不超过 5MB，node_modules、dist、build、coverage 这类目录和以点开头的目录整棵跳过，package-lock.json 与 log、lock、tmp 类文件也不收。一分钟内对同一个文件的连续改动合并成一版，免得敲一行存一次就刷出几十条。
details.en: The scope is deliberately narrow: text files only, 5MB each, whole subtrees skipped for directories like node_modules, dist, build and coverage as well as anything starting with a dot, and no package-lock.json or log, lock and tmp files. Consecutive edits to the same file within one minute collapse into a single version, so save-on-keystroke does not produce dozens of entries.

details.zh: 每个工作区一个独立的历史数据库，保留 30 天、最多 500MB，超出的按时间从旧到新清理。macOS 的文件系统事件在并发读写下会静默丢事件（不报错也不补发），所以除了监听之外还有一轮基线扫描兜底：工作区接入时先整个扫一遍，之后每天一轮，被丢掉的那次改动最迟在下一轮进入历史。
details.en: Each workspace gets its own history database, kept for 30 days and up to 500MB, pruned oldest-first beyond that. macOS filesystem events are silently dropped under concurrent activity, with no error and no redelivery, so alongside the watcher there is a baseline sweep: a full pass when the workspace is attached, then once a day, so a dropped change reaches history on the next pass at the latest.

sources.title: feat(file-history): add text file capture policy
feat(file-history): add per-workspace sqlite snapshot store
feat(file-history): add recursive workspace watcher
feat(file-history): add capture orchestration service
fix(file-history): tolerate silent fsevents event loss
feat(file-history): wire capture service into engine lifecycle
feat(file-history): add rest surface for listing and restore
feat(file-history): add unified history modal with diff and restore

title.zh: 接入 Claude Opus 5 与 Sonnet 5，普通对话默认输出提到 64K
title.en: Claude Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 wired up, default chat output raised to 64K

summary.zh: Claude Opus 5 与 Sonnet 5 的原生 Anthropic 与 OpenRouter 模型 ID 都已注册，并带上各自的自适应思考档位信息。此前选 Max 思考档会在 provider 归一那一步被悄悄降成 High，现在两条路径都原样保留。同时，没有显式指定输出长度的普通对话，目标输出从 32K 或 provider 默认值统一提到 64K。
summary.en: Native Anthropic and OpenRouter model IDs for Claude Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 are registered with their adaptive thinking metadata. Choosing the Max thinking level used to be quietly normalized down to High at the provider layer; both paths now preserve it. Separately, ordinary chat with no explicit output length now targets 64K instead of 32K or the provider default.

details.zh: 提高的是默认值，不是硬抬：既不会超过模型自身的上限，也不会把 SDK 为了给剩余上下文留地方而收紧过的封顶重新撑开。
details.en: This raises a default, not a cap: it never exceeds the model's own limit, and it does not reopen a ceiling the SDK had already tightened to leave room for remaining context.

details.zh: 输出长度设置里另外给出 128K 和 256K 两个显式选项。
details.en: The output length setting adds 128K and 256K as explicit choices.

details.zh: 一个回合如果只产出了思考内容就撞上长度上限，以前会被当成正常完成，现在明确报成空回复错误，不再让你对着一片空白猜发生了什么。
details.en: A turn that produces only thinking content before hitting the length limit used to count as a normal completion; it now surfaces an explicit empty-response error instead of leaving you staring at a blank reply.

sources.title: fix(models): add Claude Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 reasoning contracts
fix(models): raise default chat output to 64K (#2320)
test(models): align provider contracts with 64K output (#2320)

title.zh: 新会话的标题按你真正打的字来取
title.en: New chats are titled from what you actually typed

summary.zh: 一条消息被存下来的时候，已经带上了一串只给模型看的信封：提醒广播、引用条目列表，以及代表随消息一起发出的文件的附件与会话文件标记。生成标题读的是这段原始文本，于是没配摘要模型的人拿到的标题就是一段标记文本截断成 30 个字，配了摘要模型的人则把整个摘要输入都花在了信封上。现在标题生成读的是一层剥掉信封的可见文本投影：剥完什么都不剩就干脆不生成，侧边栏退回同样剥过的第一条消息。
summary.en: By the time a message is stored it already carries envelopes written for the model only: reminder broadcasts, reference listings, and the attachment and session-file markers that stand in for files sent alongside it. Title generation read that raw text, so anyone without a summarizer model configured got a title that was marker text truncated to 30 characters, while anyone with one spent the entire summarizer input on envelopes. Titles are now derived from a visible-text projection with the envelopes stripped; when nothing remains, no title is generated at all and the sidebar falls back to the same projection of the first message.

details.zh: 存量里已经是信封字面量的标题会被一次性清掉，这样老会话不会一直顶着一段标记文本。只删不改写，不会替你猜一个标题。
details.en: Stored titles that are envelope literals are removed once, so old chats stop displaying marker text. Entries are only deleted, never rewritten, so nothing is guessed on your behalf.

details.zh: 同一处缺口也让消息重试和编辑失明过：编辑一条以延迟工具清单开头的消息，重新提交时那份清单会被丢掉。现在会把消息开头的每一层信封都吃掉，而不是只认提醒那一种。
details.en: The same gap had left message retry and edit blind: editing a message that opened with a deferred-tool listing dropped that listing from the resubmitted prompt. Every envelope at the head of a prompt is now consumed, not just the reminder kind.

details.zh: 行为上有一处变化：一条只有附件、没有文字的首条消息，从此不生成标题，而不是像以前那样拿标记文本凑一个出来。
details.en: One behavior change: a first message consisting only of attachments now produces no title at all, where it previously produced one made of marker text.

sources.title: fix(sessions): title new chats from what the user typed, not injected envelopes

title.zh: 换成装不下当前对话的模型时，先问你，不再偷偷截断历史
title.en: Switching to a model that cannot hold the conversation now asks first

summary.zh: 在会话中途切换模型，如果目标模型的上下文放不下当前这段对话，以前会自动压缩或截断历史再切过去，你事后才发现前面的内容没了。现在这种切换会在动历史之前就被拒绝，并且明确告诉你需要先压缩，压不压由你决定。
summary.en: Switching models mid-conversation used to auto-compact or truncate history when the target model's context could not hold it, and you only found out afterwards that earlier content was gone. Such a switch is now rejected before any history is touched, with a clear message that you need to compact first; whether to do so is your call.

details.zh: 拒绝发生在改动历史之前，所以失败的切换不会留下任何半途的痕迹。
details.en: The rejection happens before history is mutated, so a failed switch leaves nothing half-applied behind.

details.zh: 错误信息是本地化的，模型切换接口也会把这个原因原样返回，而不是笼统地报一个失败。
details.en: The error is localized, and the model-switch endpoint returns the same reason rather than a generic failure.

sources.title: fix(session): reject unsafe model downsizing before history mutation (#2268)

title.zh: 压缩：能从损坏的思考历史里恢复，压缩后不再被旧用量卡住
title.en: Compaction recovers from damaged reasoning history and no longer inherits stale usage

summary.zh: 两件都发生在压缩前后的事。一是有些模型要求重放的工具调用必须带上思考数据，历史一旦缺了这块，压缩就整个失败；现在会精确剪掉最短的那一段完整的受损旧工具事务，真的救不回来时返回一个说明得清的 422，而不是一个笼统的 500 或者悄悄退回原生兜底。二是压缩之后的第一条回复：压缩前的用量记录会被当成还在生效，把后面的输出额度提前吃掉，现在只有确认比当前摘要更新的用量才算数。
summary.en: Two problems around compaction. First, some models require reasoning data on replayed tool calls, and a history missing it made compaction fail outright; it now trims only the shortest complete damaged old tool transaction, and returns a structured 422 that explains itself when a history genuinely cannot be salvaged, instead of a generic 500 or a silent fallback. Second, the first reply after compaction: usage recorded before the compaction was still treated as live and ate into the later output budget, and only usage proven newer than the current summary now counts.

details.zh: 剪裁的边界是「最短的一段完整的受损旧事务」，不是遇到问题就往前削一大片。
details.en: The trim boundary is the shortest complete damaged old transaction, not a broad sweep backwards whenever something looks wrong.

details.zh: 重复压缩同一段对话也不会再累积旧用量。
details.en: Compacting the same conversation repeatedly no longer accumulates stale usage.

sources.title: fix(compaction): recover malformed reasoning history (#2326)
fix(compaction): reset output usage epoch after summaries (#2320)

title.zh: 跨会话工具不再在草稿还没确认时就说消息已发出
title.en: The cross-session tool no longer says a message was sent while it is still a draft

summary.zh: 同一个 session 工具管着三件不同的事，此前共用一句「跟另一个会话联系上了」，两头都不准：读取和列举只是看了看别的会话，说联系上了言过其实；而发送和新建的那一刻消息根本没送出去，只生成了一张待确认的草稿卡，工具行抢在卡片前面宣布结果，跟卡片上待确认的状态直接打架。现在按动作分成三档，发送和新建这两档的完成文案明说在等你确认。
summary.en: One session tool covers three different actions, and all three shared a single line about having reached another chat, which fit none of them: reading and listing merely looked at another chat, and for send and create the message had not gone anywhere yet, only a pending draft card awaiting your confirmation. The tool line announced a result ahead of the card and contradicted the pending state shown on it. The three actions are now separated, and the send and create wordings say plainly that they are waiting for you.

details.zh: 工具行右侧那格以前落到通用分支，显示的是动作名或一串会话 ID。现在显示目标会话的助手名与标题，点一下就切过去；查不到（会话已归档或不在列表里）就退回 ID 短尾，不猜也不静默。
details.en: The detail cell on the right of the tool line used to fall through to a generic branch showing an action name or a raw session id. It now shows the target chat's agent name and title and switches to it on click; when the chat cannot be found, because it is archived or not listed, it falls back to a short id rather than guessing or going silent.

sources.title: fix(chat): scope session tool wording by action

title.zh: 工具集合变化不再弹出打断对话的刷新提示
title.en: A changing tool set no longer interrupts the conversation with a refresh prompt

summary.zh: 以前工具集合一有变化，就会提示你刷新并压缩会话，正说着话被打断一次。这个提示连同它背后的整套记账一起移除了。需要主动更新时，手动的重新压缩动作一直都在，随时可用。
summary.en: A change in the available tool set used to prompt you to refresh and compact the session, interrupting you mid-conversation. That notice and the bookkeeping behind it are removed. When you do want to bring things up to date, the manual fresh-compact action is still there and always available.

details.zh: 提醒类功能是否可用的检查保留下来了，去掉的只是那条打断对话的提示。
details.en: The availability checks behind reminders are kept; only the interrupting notice is gone.

sources.title: fix(session): remove tool refresh prompt

title.zh: 更新检查收敛到一个来源，失败看得见、重试不限次
title.en: Update checks use one source, failures stay visible, retries are unlimited

summary.zh: 公开渠道的更新检查以前会在多个来源之间辗转，失败信息容易被吞掉，手动重试还有次数上限。现在每次检查只对 GitHub 发起一次有限次重试的尝试，失败就明明白白留在界面上，手动重试想点几次点几次。
summary.en: Update checks on the public channel used to shuffle between several sources, failures were easy to swallow, and manual retries had a cap. Each check now makes one bounded attempt against GitHub, failures stay visible on screen, and manual retry is available as often as you want.

details.zh: 覆盖稳定版与测试版的外壳检查、内容更新清单、更新状态文案、手动重试和后台轮询五处。
details.en: This covers stable and beta shell checks, content update manifests, update status wording, manual retry and background polling.

sources.title: fix(updates): use one retryable GitHub source (#2290 #2303 #2306)

title.zh: 首次设置少一步，并且完成前会回读确认真的写进去了
title.en: First-run setup is one step shorter and verifies settings before finishing

summary.zh: 首次设置以前会在写入被拒时继续往下走，最后标记为完成，你以为配好了其实没有。现在每一步都会解析到真正的目标助手，写入被拒就停下，并且在标记完成之前把设置回读一遍确认。同时主题选择这一步移除了，流程从七步变成六步，选完模型直接进工作区设置——主题在设置里随时能改，没必要在第一次打开时挡在路上。
summary.en: First-run setup used to keep going when a write was rejected and still mark itself complete, leaving you believing things were configured when they were not. Each step now resolves the actual target agent, stops on a rejected write, and reads the settings back before marking setup done. The theme step is also removed, taking the flow from seven steps to six and going straight from model selection to workspace setup: the theme is changeable in settings at any time and did not need to stand in the way on first launch.

details.zh: 覆盖首次运行时的助手、供应商、模型、语言、记忆和工作区设置。
details.en: This covers first-run agent, provider, model, language, memory and workspace setup.

details.zh: 普通的主题设置没有任何变化，只是不再出现在首次设置流程里。
details.en: Normal theme settings are unchanged; the theme simply no longer appears in the first-run flow.

sources.title: fix(onboarding): verify settings before completion (#2293)
fix(onboarding): remove the theme step (#2271)

title.zh: 图像生成能从被拒的缓存凭证里自救，Seedream 5.0 接上官方模型
title.en: Image generation recovers from a rejected cached credential, Seedream 5.0 wired to the official model

summary.zh: 存下来的访问令牌有可能在记录的过期时间之前就被服务方拒掉，这时图像生成会直接失败。现在它会在凭证文件锁的保护下轮换一次 OAuth 凭证并重试；第二次还被拒，就把服务方的原始错误如实抛出来，不再自作主张。图像模型这边补上了 Seedream 5.0 的官方标准模型，Lite 仍然是默认；写错的模型 ID 会明确报错，而不是悄悄落到 Lite。
summary.en: A stored access token can be rejected by the provider before its recorded expiry, and image generation simply failed. It now rotates the OAuth credential under the credential file lock and retries once; if it is rejected a second time the provider's own error is surfaced unchanged rather than papered over. On the model side, Seedream 5.0's official standard model is added with Lite still the default, and an unknown explicit model id now fails instead of silently becoming Lite.

details.zh: 还有一处相关的修复：给视觉等辅助任务解析模型时，供应商凭证只负责提供认证信息，不再覆盖已经解析好的模型访问地址，OAuth 的资源地址和显式指定的工具模型仍然说了算。
details.en: A related fix: when resolving models for vision and other auxiliary tasks, provider credentials now supply authentication only and no longer overwrite an already-resolved model endpoint, leaving OAuth resource URLs and explicit utility overrides authoritative.

sources.title: fix(media): recover image generation when the provider rejects a cached OAuth token
fix(media): add official Seedream 5.0 model (#2305)
fix(vision): preserve resolved model endpoints (#2322)

title.zh: 新建会话失败不再白建一场，子任务失败也会把父任务叫醒
title.en: A failed chat creation is no longer wasted, and a failed subagent still wakes its parent

summary.zh: 两处会让工作卡住的问题。新建会话以前在第一条消息发失败时会把整件事一并算失败，你得从头再来；现在只有真正通过了发送前检查才算创建成功，失败时新建的会话保留下来，重试只重试那条消息。子任务这边，失败或中止的运行以前可能不回头通知父任务，父任务就一直等在那；现在每一个终止结果，包括失败和中止，都会带着状态明确唤醒父任务。
summary.en: Two ways work could stall. Creating a chat used to fail as a whole when its first message failed, leaving you to start over; creation is now acknowledged only after the message passes real preflight, and on failure the created chat is kept so only that message is retried. On the subagent side, a failed or aborted run could fail to report back and leave the parent waiting; every terminal result, failure and abort included, now explicitly wakes the parent turn with its status.

details.zh: 跨会话投递的回执、重试行为，以及模型和助手的校验都跟着这次修正。
details.en: Cross-session delivery receipts, retry behavior, and model and agent validation are corrected along with it.

details.zh: 直接派发的子任务和 subagent_reply 续跑两条路径都覆盖到了。
details.en: Both direct subagent dispatch and subagent_reply continuations are covered.

sources.title: fix(sessions): preserve failed session.create results (#2282)
fix(subagents): resume parent after failed runs (#2337)

title.zh: 其余修复：MCP 工具名、设置弹窗层级、插件选文件、飞书与 Kimi
title.en: Other fixes: MCP tool names, settings dialog layering, plugin file picks, Feishu and Kimi

summary.zh: 一批范围较小但会实际挡路的修复。模型看到的 MCP 工具名统一成稳定的小写 ID，重名会直接报错而不是悄悄互相覆盖，界面上显示的名字和线路上传的名字都不变，历史记录里的旧键仍然读得出来。设置页里弹出的确认框以前会被压在设置层下面，点不到也按不掉，现在稳稳浮在上面。插件请求选单个文件时，从此真的打开单选对话框。延迟执行的 MCP 调用把参数声明成开放的 JSON 对象，非对象的参数在交给连接器之前就被挡下，不再带着错型的参数一路跑到连接器里才炸。飞书的流式卡片按协议要求把设置包进一层信封，Kimi 的 K3 请求去掉了它不支持的温度参数。
summary.en: A batch of smaller fixes that were nonetheless in the way. The MCP tool names the model sees are now stable lowercase ids, with collisions raising an error instead of quietly shadowing each other, while displayed and wire names stay as they were and historical keys remain readable. Confirmation dialogs opened from settings used to sit behind the settings layer where they could be neither clicked nor dismissed, and now float properly above it. A plugin asking for a single file finally opens a single-select dialog. Deferred MCP calls now advertise their arguments as an open JSON object and reject non-object values before they reach the connector, instead of carrying a malformed argument all the way in before it blows up. Feishu's streaming cards wrap their settings in the envelope the protocol requires, and Kimi's K3 requests drop the temperature parameter it does not support.

details.zh: MCP 那一处覆盖工具发布、目录查找、权限、置顶、按助手启用，以及恢复会话时的工具快照。
details.en: The MCP change covers tool publication, catalog lookup, permissions, pins, per-agent enablement, and the tool snapshot restored with a session.

details.zh: 设置里的连接器移除和传输方式切换这两处确认框受益最明显。
details.en: Removing a connector and changing its transport mode are where the dialog fix shows most.

details.zh: 插件请求目录仍然是单选，没指定选项时仍然是多选，只有明确要求单个文件的那一种变了。
details.en: Directory picks stay single, omitted options stay multi-select, and only an explicit request for one file changes behavior.

details.zh: 自动化任务的模型选择器改成按供应商分组，两个供应商有同名或同 ID 的模型时也不会选错。
details.en: The automation model picker now groups choices by provider, so overlapping model names or ids across providers no longer select the wrong one.

sources.title: fix(mcp): canonicalize model-facing tool ids (#2278)
fix(mcp): require object arguments in bridge schema (#2311)
fix(settings): keep nested confirmations above settings
fix(plugins): honor single-file resource picks (#2283)
fix(automation): group model choices by provider (#2281)
fix(feishu): nest CardKit streaming settings (#2335)
fix(kimi): omit unsupported K3 temperature

summary.zh: 这一版没有新功能，全是修复。最显眼的是桌面端进程区的工具行：以前有一批工具只显示一句通用的「正在忙碌中」，插件工具的文案从写下那天起就没匹配过任何一次调用，失败的工具还会显示成功文案配一个失败图标，这三处都补齐了，完成和失败两档也改写成脱离上下文能独立读懂。Windows 上另一件事更实际：安装目录从父目录继承的孤立 AppContainer SID 会让 Chromium 的 GPU 沙箱起不来，反复崩溃后应用自动降到兼容模式就再也回不去，现在安装器和应用启动时都会修复这个权限并给一次恢复探测的机会，仍然崩溃的机器会被还原回原来的兼容模式。分叉出来的会话里，分叉之前的文件和资源链接重新能打开；同一个文件换一种大小写拼法登记不再多出一条记录。安全面上，插件配置文件、几处迁移产物和签名密钥目录都纳入了只属主可读写的范围，启动时会巡检并纠正存量。
summary.en: This release has no new features; it is all fixes. The most visible one is the tool lines in the desktop activity area: a batch of tools only ever showed a generic "working on it", the labels written for plugin tools had never once matched a real call, and a failed tool showed the success wording next to a failure icon. All three are fixed, and the done and failed wordings are rewritten to read on their own out of context. On Windows something more practical: an orphaned AppContainer SID inherited from a parent directory keeps Chromium's GPU sandbox from starting, and once repeated crashes push the app into compatibility mode it never comes back. The installer and the app startup now both repair that permission and grant one recovery probe; machines that still crash are restored to the compatibility mode they had. In forked sessions, files and resource links captured before the fork open again, and registering the same file under a different spelling of its case no longer creates a second entry. On the security side, plugin configuration files, several migration outputs and the signing key directory come under owner-only permissions, with existing files checked and corrected at startup.

title.zh: 进程区的工具行说清楚每个工具在做什么
title.en: Tool lines in the activity area now say what each tool is doing

summary.zh: 进程区每条工具调用的文案只有一个取值点，对不上就静默落到通用兜底「正在忙碌中」。此前有三处漏洞：一方工具漏配 9 个（文件、会话、subagent 回复与关闭、循环控制、素材落盘、频道读取上下文与回复转交）；插件工具注册时会被加上插件 id 前缀，而语言包里的键没带前缀，6 组插件文案从写下那天起就没匹配过任何一次调用；取文案时只传进行中和已完成两个相位，失败相位从未被渲染，失败的工具会显示成功文案配一个失败图标。三处都补齐了。
summary.en: Every tool line in the activity area resolves its wording through a single lookup, and anything that misses falls silently back to a generic "working on it". Three holes had opened up: nine first-party tools had no wording at all (file, session, subagent reply and close, loop control, materialize, channel read-context, reply and pass); plugin tools are registered under a plugin-id prefix while the language packs held unprefixed keys, so six sets of plugin wordings had never matched a single call since the day they were written; and the lookup only ever passed the running and done phases, so the failed phase was never rendered and a failed tool showed the success wording next to a failure icon. All three are closed.

details.zh: 插件工具改成先查带前缀的键，未命中落到插件兜底，不走「剥掉前缀再查一次」那条捷径：第三方插件里叫 read 或 write 的工具会直接撞上内置工具的文案。
details.en: Plugin tools now look up the prefixed key first and fall back to a plugin-generic wording, rather than taking the shortcut of stripping the prefix and looking again: a third-party plugin's own read or write tool would collide head-on with the built-in wording.

details.zh: 已完成和失败两档改成脱离上下文也能独立读懂。这两档会长期留在会话记录里，而单工具调用的行永不折叠，旁边没有任何东西能补出主语和宾语。
details.en: The done and failed wordings are rewritten to read on their own out of context. Those two stay in the transcript indefinitely, and a single tool call's line never collapses, so nothing beside it supplies the missing subject and object.

details.zh: 措辞上区分两类词：用户接触过的（loop、workflow、PDF）保留原名，内部实现命名（capabilities、materialize、read_context）换成用户感知得到的说法。
details.en: The wording separates two kinds of term: names you have actually met (loop, workflow, PDF) keep their own spelling, while internal implementation names (capabilities, materialize, read_context) are replaced by what you would perceive them as.

details.zh: subagent 在中文里此前有「子会话」「子代理」两种叫法指同一个东西，统一为 subagent；日韩沿用各自既有的音译；繁体中文里三条漏转的简体一并转繁。
details.en: Chinese had been calling the same thing by two different names for subagent; they are unified. Japanese and Korean keep their established transliterations, and three untranslated strings in Traditional Chinese are converted.

sources.title: fix(chat): tool line wordings now say what each tool is doing

title.zh: Windows 上因 GPU 沙箱起不来而降级的机器恢复硬件加速
title.en: Windows machines downgraded by a failing GPU sandbox recover hardware acceleration

summary.zh: 根因是安装目录从父目录继承了孤立的 AppContainer SID（electron/electron#51761），Chromium 的 GPU 沙箱因此起不来。反复崩溃后应用会自动降到兼容模式，然后一直留在那里，因为没有任何东西会去解除降级。现在安装器在每次安装和更新时给安装目录授予受限应用包的读取执行权限，应用启动时也做同一处修复，随后清掉自动降级状态，给一次恢复探测的机会；修复后仍然崩溃的机器会被还原回原来的兼容模式，不会陷入反复崩溃。
summary.en: The root cause is an orphaned AppContainer SID inherited from a parent directory (electron/electron#51761), which keeps Chromium's GPU sandbox from starting. Repeated crashes push the app into an automatic compatibility mode, and it stays there, because nothing ever lifts the downgrade. The installer now grants restricted-app-packages read and execute on the install directory on every install and update, the app applies the same grant at startup, and the automatic downgrade state is then cleared for one recovery probe. A machine that still crashes afterwards is restored to the compatibility mode it had, so it never falls into a crash loop.

details.zh: 安装器侧的授权是幂等的，失败不阻断安装；应用侧的修复按安装身份只做一次。
details.en: The installer-side grant is idempotent and non-fatal on failure; the app-side repair runs once per install identity.

details.zh: 修复排在 GPU 启动策略解析之前，所以同一次启动就能吃到效果，不需要先白启动一次。
details.en: The repair runs before the GPU startup policy is resolved, so it takes effect on the same launch rather than needing a throwaway one first.

sources.title: GPU acceleration stuck in compatibility mode on Windows
fix(gpu): heal the Windows install-dir sandbox ACE and probe GPU recovery
fix(desktop): run the install ACL heal before resolving the GPU startup policy
fix(installer): grant the restricted-app-packages ACE on the install directory
fix(gpu): add recovery primitives to the GPU startup state store

title.zh: 分叉会话里，分叉之前的文件和资源链接重新能打开
title.en: In forked sessions, files and resource links from before the fork open again

summary.zh: 分叉出来的会话会把父会话的文件 id 记成旧别名，但有几处查找只认当前 id：打开媒体查看器、文件引用去重、插件解析会话文件引用，以及转写里在分叉前捕获的资源链接。这些地方现在都会连同旧别名一起匹配（有记录路径时也一并比对），按 id 的兜底查找也收窄到所属会话内，让它的旧别名解析真正生效。
summary.en: A forked session records its parent's file ids as legacy aliases, but several lookups matched only the current id: opening the media viewer, deduplicating file references, a plugin resolving a session-file reference, and resource links captured in the transcript before the fork. All of them now match the aliases too (and recorded paths where available), and the by-id fallback is scoped to the owning session so its legacy resolution actually applies.

sources.title: fix(desktop): match session files through legacy ids in renderer lookups
fix(resources): resolve resource links through legacy session file ids

title.zh: 同一个文件换一种大小写拼法不再登记成两份
title.en: The same file under a different spelling of its case no longer registers twice

summary.zh: 会话文件去重比较的是保留调用方大小写的路径字符串，所以同一个文件换一种拼法再登记就会多出一条记录，带自己的 id 和读取授权。现在统一走共享的文件身份键：原生规范化，并在忽略大小写的平台上折叠大小写。已有条目保留原 id——去重能在任何拼法下找到并复用它们，磁盘上不改写任何东西。
summary.en: Session file deduplication compared realpath strings that preserve the caller's casing, so registering the same file under a different spelling created a second entry with its own id and read grant. Comparison now goes through the shared filesystem identity key: native canonicalization, case-folded where the platform ignores case. Existing entries keep their ids, since deduplication finds and reuses them under any spelling and nothing on disk is rewritten.

details.zh: 同一套规范化也收敛到了路径授权与包含关系的比较上，此前几个模块各带一份互有出入的私有实现。Windows 上短名（8.3）变体因此同样被视作同一个路径；POSIX 上的比较不变。
details.en: The same canonicalization is converged onto grant and containment comparisons, which several modules had been carrying slightly divergent private copies of. On Windows a short-name (8.3) variant is therefore treated as the same path; POSIX comparisons are unchanged.

sources.title: fix(session-files): compare file identity case-insensitively where the filesystem does
refactor(fs): converge path canonicalization on the shared link-aware primitives

title.zh: 插件配置、迁移产物和签名密钥目录纳入只属主可读写
title.en: Plugin configs, migration outputs and the signing key directory come under owner-only permissions

summary.zh: 上一版把凭证文件改成只有你自己能读写，这一版补齐覆盖面。插件配置文件可能存着连接器和第三方服务的密钥，现在与其它凭证走同一个只属主的写入方式。几处数据迁移在改写 agent 配置和模型文件时会先落一个默认权限的临时文件，崩溃在改名之前就会永久留下一份可读副本，这些写入也改走同一条路。签名密钥和授权记录所在的安全目录写下时本就是只属主，但之后没有任何东西纠正过它——备份恢复或复制数据目录带回来的宽松权限会一直留着，现在启动时的权限巡检会走一遍这棵树。
summary.en: The previous release made credential files readable only by you; this one fills in the coverage. Plugin configuration files can hold connector and third-party service credentials, and are now written with the same owner-only primitive as the other credential stores. Several data migrations rewrote agent configurations and provider model files through a plain temporary file with default permissions, where a crash before the rename would leave a readable copy behind indefinitely; those writes take the same route now. The security directory holding signing keys and grant records was already written owner-only, but nothing ever corrected it afterwards, so loose permissions reintroduced by a backup restore or a copied data directory stayed forever. The startup permission pass now walks that tree.

details.zh: 启动巡检还覆盖了按 agent 的配置备份（包括迁移检查点里的那些），以及 agent 配置旁边残留的临时副本。
details.en: The startup pass also covers the per-agent configuration backups, including those inside migration checkpoints, and any leftover temporary copy sitting next to an agent configuration.

details.zh: 插件那边只碰配置文件本身，插件数据目录的其余部分归别的所有者，保持原有权限。
details.en: On the plugin side only the configuration file itself is touched; the rest of a plugin's data directory belongs to other owners and keeps whatever modes it has.

sources.title: fix(plugins): write plugin configuration files through the owner-only store
fix(storage): bring the security key directory under the custody pass
fix(storage): write credential-bearing migration outputs owner-only
fix(storage): write the remaining credential migrations owner-only
fix(storage): broaden the startup custody pass and the persistence scan

title.zh: 英文插件指南补齐三节，provider 兼容层参考重写
title.en: Three sections added to the English plugin guide, provider-compat reference rewritten

summary.zh: 英文插件指南缺了中文指南已有的三节：Agent 辅助开发流程、开发场景、诊断面板。翻译前先对着当前代码核验了它们描述的 API，现在两份指南都是同样的 13 个顶层章节。provider 兼容层的参考文档还在把这一层描述成 JavaScript，12 个相对链接全部指向不存在的文件，模块表只列了目录里 19 个文件中的 8 个——Kimi、LongCat、OpenRouter、Anthropic 这些看起来像是压根没有兼容层。链接全部修正，模块按分发实际遍历的顺序列全，并把与 provider 无关的辅助函数拆成单独一张表。
summary.en: The English plugin guide was missing three sections the Chinese one already had: the agent-assisted development loop, development scenarios, and the diagnostics panel. The APIs they document were verified against the current code before translating, and both guides now carry the same 13 top-level sections. The provider-compat reference still described that layer as JavaScript, so all twelve of its relative links resolved to nothing, and its module table listed only 8 of the 19 files in the directory, making providers such as Kimi, LongCat, OpenRouter and Anthropic look like they had no compat layer at all. The links are corrected, every module is listed in the order dispatch actually walks them, and the provider-agnostic helpers are split into a table of their own.

sources.title: docs: refresh provider-compat reference and sync English plugin guide

summary.zh: 这一版最大的新东西是 /loop：给它一个任务，助手会在当前会话里反复推进，自己决定下一次什么时候醒来，直到宣布完成或者撞上轮数上限，桌面端和聊天平台都能用，重启也接得回来。DeepSeek 新增 Responses 协议通道，同时修掉两处一直在悄悄改写你选择的行为：思考档位 low 和 medium 都被折成 high，以及思考模式下输出预算被强行抬到 65536 或 131072，而且专挑上下文快满的时候抬。中日韩界面下操作失败终于说人话了，以前会直接甩一句英文加一串机器码，原文移到可展开的详情里方便报 bug。Unix 上的凭证文件和数据目录改成只有你自己能读写，启动时检查一次并纠正存量。拖文件夹进来不再复制一份，改成引用原地址，文件夹里有多少文件、有没有 symlink 都不再影响能否附上。另外有一条你应该知道的放宽：git push 的强推、推 tag、推全部分支这些变体不再被无条件硬拦，改成跟其它命令一样走会话权限模式，其中自动模式是直接放行。
summary.en: The headline of this release is /loop: hand it a task and the assistant keeps working on it in the current session, deciding for itself when to wake up next, until it declares the goal met or hits the turn ceiling. It works from the desktop and from chat platforms, and survives a restart. DeepSeek gains a Responses protocol channel, and two behaviours that had been quietly rewriting your choices are fixed: low and medium thinking tiers were both folded into high, and in thinking mode the output budget was forced up to 65536 or 131072 precisely when the context window was nearly full. Chinese, Japanese and Korean interfaces now report failures in your own language instead of an English sentence and a machine code; the original English moves into an expandable detail area for bug reports. On Unix, credential files and the data directory become owner-only, with existing files checked and corrected once per launch. Dropped folders are referenced in place rather than copied, so neither the number of files inside nor the presence of symlinks affects whether a folder can be attached. One relaxation you should know about: the force-push, push-tags and push-all-branches variants of git push are no longer hard-blocked and now follow the session permission mode, which in auto mode means they are allowed outright.

title.zh: /loop：交一个任务，让它自己推进到做完
title.en: /loop: hand over a task and let it run itself to completion

summary.zh: `/loop <任务>` 会在当前会话里开一条循环：每轮结束后助手自己决定下一次什么时候醒来，带上留给自己的上下文，醒来继续推进，直到它宣布任务完成，或者用完轮数预算自动暂停。`/loop status` 看进度，`/loop pause` 和 `/loop resume` 暂停恢复，`/loop stop` 终止。桌面端斜杠菜单里有入口，Telegram 这类聊天平台上同样能用，那边到点会主动给你发消息。
summary.en: `/loop <task>` opens a loop in the current session: after each turn the assistant decides when to wake up next and what context to carry forward, then resumes, until it declares the goal met or pauses itself on running out of turn budget. `/loop status` shows progress, `/loop pause` and `/loop resume` suspend and continue, `/loop stop` ends it. There is an entry in the desktop slash menu, and it works from chat platforms such as Telegram, where the loop reaches out to you when the alarm fires.

details.zh: 轮数有预算，状态里一直显示「第几轮 / 预算多少」。用完不是终止而是自动暂停，`/loop resume` 会把计数清零再给一份新预算，所以要跑多久由你说了算，循环不会自己无声无息地跑下去。连续几轮出错、或者唤醒一直投递不出去，同样会自动暂停。
details.en: Turns are budgeted and the status line always shows turns used against that budget. Running out pauses the loop rather than ending it, and `/loop resume` clears the count and grants a fresh budget, so how long it runs stays your call and it never quietly runs on by itself. Several failed turns in a row, or a wakeup that cannot be delivered, also pause it.

details.zh: 循环状态原子写盘，应用重启后会接着恢复，不需要你重新起一遍。
details.en: Loop state is persisted atomically and recovered on boot, so a restart does not lose the loop or require you to start it again.

details.zh: 循环绑定的是会话身份而不是当前焦点。会话被重置或换代时循环会终止，在新会话里重开即可。聊天平台上这类终止和暂停会主动发一条消息说明原因；桌面端这一版还没有对应的提示，用 `/loop status` 查当前状态。
details.en: A loop is bound to session identity rather than to whatever is currently focused. Resetting or replacing the session terminates the loop, and you restart it in the new session. On chat platforms a termination or pause sends you a message explaining why; the desktop has no such prompt in this release, so use `/loop status` to see where a loop stands.

details.zh: 子代理调用这个工具会被拒绝：约闹钟和宣布完成只有主会话能做，避免一个子任务替整条循环做主。
details.en: A subagent calling this tool is refused: scheduling a wakeup and declaring completion are reserved for the main session, so a subtask cannot decide the fate of the whole loop.

title.zh: DeepSeek 新增 Responses 协议通道
title.en: DeepSeek gains a Responses protocol channel

summary.zh: DeepSeek 的 V4-Flash 开始原生支持 OpenAI Responses 协议。在此之前，就算你把模型配成 Responses，请求仍然走 ChatCompletions 的兼容路径，发出去的思考级别和输出预算都是对方不认识的字段，而 Responses 端点对不认识的参数是静默忽略，所以两项设置都无声无息地丢了。现在有了独立的 deepseek-responses 供应商，字段按 Responses 的写法翻译。
summary.en: DeepSeek's V4-Flash release added native OpenAI Responses support. Until now a model configured for Responses still went through the ChatCompletions compatibility path, sending a thinking level and an output budget under field names that endpoint does not recognise, and the Responses endpoint silently ignores unknown parameters, so both settings were dropped without a word. There is now a dedicated deepseek-responses provider that translates the fields properly.

details.zh: 它需要单独填一份 API key。复用别的供应商那条凭证会把对方的地址和协议一起带过来，等于又被拽回 ChatCompletions。
details.en: It needs its own API key entry. Reusing another provider's credential would drag that entry's base URL and protocol along, forcing the request back onto ChatCompletions.

details.zh: V4-Flash 和 V4-Pro 都列在这个供应商下面，但官方文档上 Pro 的 Responses 尚未开放，选中它发请求会被服务端拒绝。想现在就用，选 Flash。
details.en: Both V4-Flash and V4-Pro are listed under this provider, but the official docs still have Responses closed for Pro, so selecting it means the server rejects the request. Pick Flash if you want to use this today.

sources.title: feat(provider): add DeepSeek Responses channel and stop it falling back to ChatCompletions

title.zh: 接入 DeepSeek 时不再擅自改写你选的思考档位和输出长度
title.en: The DeepSeek integration stops rewriting the thinking tier and output length you chose

summary.zh: 对照 DeepSeek 官方文档逐条核过之后，发现本项目的兼容层有两处行为跟文档不符，而且都是往「悄悄换掉你的选择」的方向错。出错的是我们这边的翻译层，不是 DeepSeek 的服务。现在思考档位原样传给对方，输出预算也不再被抬高。
summary.en: Checked line by line against DeepSeek's own reference, this project's compatibility layer disagreed with the documentation in two places, and both erred toward quietly replacing your choice. The fault was in our translation layer, not in DeepSeek's service. The thinking tier now reaches the server as selected, and the output budget is no longer raised.

details.zh: 思考档位 low 之前被折进 high。官方认可的档位就是 low / high / max，low 是有效的一档，折掉等于你少了一个选项，还被推到更慢更贵的那档上。现在 low 原样传过去。medium 仍然按 high 发出，因为 DeepSeek 服务端本来就把 medium 归到 high，这一档的结果不受影响。
details.en: A low thinking tier used to be folded into high. The documented vocabulary is exactly low / high / max, so folding away a valid tier removed a step you were entitled to and pushed you onto a slower, more expensive one. Low now passes through as selected. Medium is still sent as high, because DeepSeek's own server maps medium to high anyway, so that tier's outcome is unaffected.

details.zh: 思考模式下输出预算之前会被抬到 65536 或 131072，触发条件是传入预算不超过 32768。而预算小恰恰说明上下文窗口快满了，这时候抬高等于把请求推过窗口边界。现在兼容层不再覆盖你已经定好的预算。
details.en: In thinking mode the output budget was raised to 65536 or 131072 whenever the incoming budget was at or below 32768. A small budget means the context window is nearly full, which is exactly when raising it pushes the request past the edge. The layer no longer overrides a budget you have already set.

details.zh: 请求完全没带输出预算时仍然会补一个默认值，因为 DeepSeek 那边不带预算会退到 4K 输出，思考链一占就没给答案留下空间。官方没有公布这个默认值，只建议显式声明，所以这个数字不值得赌。
details.en: A request carrying no output budget at all still gets a default supplied, because DeepSeek falls back to 4K output and a reasoning chain would leave nothing for the answer. The docs do not publish that default and recommend stating it explicitly, so the value is not worth guessing.

sources.title: fix(provider): align DeepSeek reasoning effort and thinking toggle with the documented API
fix(provider): stop the DeepSeek compat layer from overriding the output budget

title.zh: 操作失败时说你的语言
title.en: Failures now speak your language

summary.zh: 后端的错误一直是英文句子加一个机器码，前端原样贴到界面上，于是中文、日文、韩文界面下一次被拦住的分叉会告诉你「active task cannot be shared by a session fork: subagent-1785...（session_fork_active_task）」。现在二十来个真正会撞上的业务错误都有了各语言的说法，英文原文移到错误条的详情区，可以展开、可以选中复制去报 bug。
summary.en: Backend errors carry an English sentence plus a machine code, and the renderer piped that straight to the surface, so a Chinese, Japanese or Korean interface answered a blocked fork with "active task cannot be shared by a session fork: subagent-1785... (session_fork_active_task)". The couple of dozen business errors people actually hit now have copy in every language, and the original English moves into the error bar's detail area, expandable and selectable for a bug report.

details.zh: 会话分叉、会话新建与切换、能力刷新、WebSocket 错误帧以前各写各的英文句子，完全绕开了本地化。现在都走同一个出口。
details.en: Session fork, session create and switch, capability refresh and the WebSocket error frame each formatted their own English string and bypassed localization entirely. They now share one route.

details.zh: 某个语言确实没有这条文案时，会退回一句本地化的通用说明或英文原句，而不是把 error.code.sessionBusy 这种键名摆给你看。完全没有错误码的失败（比如服务端进程连原生模块都加载不了）会给一句通用说明加完整原文。
details.en: When a language genuinely lacks a phrase, it falls back to a localized general sentence or to the English original, rather than showing you a key like error.code.sessionBusy. A failure carrying no code at all, such as a server process that cannot load its native addon, gets a general sentence plus the full original text.

details.zh: 同一条错误连续出现两次时，先出现那条的定时器不会再把后出现那条提前清掉。
details.en: When the same error fires twice, the first entry's timer no longer clears the second one early.

sources.title: feat(i18n): speak the user's language when an operation fails

title.zh: 拖文件夹进来不再复制一份
title.en: Dropped folders are referenced, not copied

summary.zh: 以前拖一个文件夹进来会把里面的文件整个复制进会话缓存，还会挨个清点：内部文件数会吃掉附件额度，里面有 symlink 就直接被拒。现在文件夹登记为原地址的引用，不搬字节也不递归清点，文件夹本身占 1 个附件额度，里面装多少东西都不影响（文件夹本身是 symlink、或指向敏感路径，仍然会被挡）。
summary.en: Dropping a folder used to copy its contents into the session cache and count them one by one: the number of files inside ate into the attachment allowance, and a symlink anywhere within meant outright rejection. A folder is now registered as a reference to its original location, with no bytes moved and no recursive counting, so it takes a single attachment slot no matter what it holds. A folder that is itself a symlink, or that sits on a sensitive path, is still blocked.

details.zh: 代价是这个附件不再是快照：把原文件夹删了或移走，历史记录里那个附件会显示为缺失，而不是留着一份当时的副本。
details.en: The trade-off is that the attachment is no longer a snapshot: delete or move the original and the attachment shows as missing in history, rather than keeping a copy of how it looked at the time.

details.zh: 助手对会话附件的 ls / grep / find 现在都能直接按 fileId 指定目标；对一个文件夹类附件执行「读取」会返回该怎么做的说明，而不是抛一个 EISDIR。
details.en: The assistant's ls, grep and find now accept a session attachment by id, and asking it to read a folder attachment returns guidance on what to do instead of failing with EISDIR.

sources.title: feat(attachments): directory attachments become path references; session-file agent access goes through ResourceIO

title.zh: 本机凭证文件收紧为只有你自己能读写
title.en: Local credential files become owner-only

summary.zh: 供应商目录与模型缓存、跨助手的全局模型配置、OAuth 令牌、每个助手的配置（里面有供应商和通道凭证）、设备与本地用户记录、网页会话、本地定义的供应商插件（各自带着自己的 key），以及这些文件的迁移备份和迁移检查点，在 Unix 上现在都以「仅所有者可读写」创建，数据目录本身也是。已经存在的文件每次启动检查一次，跟预期不符就纠正，每次纠正都会记一条日志。
summary.en: The provider catalog and model cache, the cross-assistant global model config, OAuth tokens, each assistant's config (which holds provider and channel credentials), device and local-user records, web sessions, locally defined provider plugins (each carrying its own key), and the migration backups and checkpoints of all these are now created owner-only on Unix, as is the data directory itself. Existing files are checked once per launch and corrected when they differ, with every correction logged.

details.zh: 供应商目录能正常读出且有内容之后，超过 90 天的迁移备份会被清理掉。
details.en: Migration backups older than 90 days are removed once the live provider catalog reads back cleanly and is populated.

details.zh: Windows 不受影响：这个平台没有实现这套权限位，它的文件接口也表达不了。
details.en: Windows is unchanged: the platform does not implement these permission bits and its file API cannot express them.

details.zh: 权限调整是尽力而为。碰上不支持 POSIX 权限的文件系统，改不动就改不动，绝不会因此中断一次保存或一次启动，失败只写进日志。
details.en: The permission work is best-effort. On a filesystem without POSIX permissions the change simply does not stick, and it never interrupts a save or a launch; failures only go to the log.

sources.title: chore(storage): write local credential files owner-only and verify at startup
fix(storage): heal the local provider plugin tree the store actually writes to

title.zh: 邀请码开通测试更新通道
title.en: An invite code opens a test update channel

summary.zh: 邀请码解锁的是一条独立的更新地址，而不是给应用本身加门禁。核销在主进程里完成，请求只带上邀请码和一个本地生成的设备标识的哈希，不上送版本、平台或任何机器指纹，设备标识原文也不出本机。
summary.en: An invite code unlocks a separate update address rather than gating the app itself. Redemption happens in the main process, and the request carries only the code and a hash of a locally generated device identifier. No version, platform or machine fingerprint is sent, and the identifier itself never leaves your machine.

details.zh: 真正切换通道之前会先让你确认一件事：测试版装上之后无法回退到当前的稳定版。你接受了才切。
details.en: Before the channel actually switches you must accept that a test build cannot be rolled back to the current stable release. Only then does it switch.

details.zh: 测试通道不会在出问题时偷偷回落到公开发布源。那边失败就如实报告，不会把你不声不响地拉回稳定版。
details.en: The test channel never quietly falls back to the public release source. A failure there is reported honestly instead of pulling you back to stable behind your back.

details.zh: 没有配置核销地址的构建，设置页根本不显示邀请入口。
details.en: A build with no redemption endpoint configured renders no invite entry at all.

sources.title: feat(updater): invite-gated test update channel
feat(invite): add the invite-redemption worker behind the alpha update channel

title.zh: git push 的危险变体改走会话权限模式
title.en: Dangerous git push variants now follow the session permission mode

summary.zh: 强推（`--force`、`-f`、`--force-with-lease`、以及 `+分支` 这种 refspec 写法）、推 tag（`--tags`、`--follow-tags`）、`--all` 和 `--mirror`，原先在任何模式下都被产品层无条件拦死。现在这些变体跟其它命令一样交给会话权限模式处理：询问模式会问你，自动模式**直接放行**，完整权限模式放行，只读模式拒绝。
summary.en: Force pushes (`--force`, `-f`, `--force-with-lease`, and the `+branch` refspec form), tag pushes (`--tags`, `--follow-tags`), `--all` and `--mirror` used to be blocked unconditionally at the product level in every mode. They now go through the session permission mode like any other command: the ask mode prompts you, the auto mode **allows them outright**, full access allows them, and read-only refuses.

details.zh: 这是一次放宽，覆盖面比字面上那几个长选项更广，请按需要调整你的会话权限模式。硬安全网现在只剩下工作区文件投递这一条边界。
details.en: This is a relaxation, and it covers more spellings than the long options alone, so set your session permission mode accordingly. The hard safety gate now enforces only the workspace file-delivery boundary.

sources.title: fix(permission): route dangerous git push variants through normal permission flow

title.zh: 延迟加载多了一级内置工具开关，位置也挪到了该在的地方
title.en: A second defer switch for built-in tools, moved somewhere it belongs

summary.zh: 主开关延迟加载连接器工具；新增的二级开关把延迟扩展到内置工具，默认关闭，而且只有主开关开着时才能用。这组开关本来对所有连接器都生效，却藏在每个连接器详情页里，现在挪到了 MCP 设置页顶层，跟主开关放在一起。
summary.en: The master switch defers connector tools; a new second switch extends deferral to built-in tools, off by default and usable only while the master is on. These controls apply to every connector yet lived inside each connector's detail page, and now sit at the top level of the MCP settings page next to the master switch.

details.zh: 连接器详情页的权限区块现在只保留该连接器自己的复审策略。
details.en: The permission section of a connector's detail page now keeps only that connector's own review policy.

sources.title: feat(mcp): two-tier defer switches with the built-in tier gated by the master
fix(settings): move the global defer controls to the connector tab's top level

title.zh: 同一个文件不会再因为路径写法不同被重复上传
title.en: One file no longer uploads twice over a difference in spelling

summary.zh: 重复上传同一个文件本来会复用上一次的副本，判断依据是一个从路径算出来的去重键。但上传路径解析路径的方式和其它入口不一致，同一个文件换一种写法（Windows 上的 8.3 短名，macOS 上的大小写）就会算出不同的键，于是被当成两个文件，各复制一份进会话缓存。现在上传路径的写法跟其它入口统一了。
summary.en: Uploading the same file again is supposed to reuse the previous copy, decided by a dedupe key derived from its path. But the upload route resolved paths differently from every other entry point, so the same file spelled another way (an 8.3 short name on Windows, different letter case on macOS) produced a different key, counted as two files, and was copied into the session cache twice. The upload path now spells paths the same way every other entry point does.

details.zh: 这不是某个平台独有的毛病：macOS 上用与磁盘不同的大小写拼一个已存在的路径，同样会分叉。
details.en: This was not specific to one platform: on macOS, spelling an existing path with different letter case than the disk has produces the same split.

sources.title: fix(upload): align the upload route's realpath with the session-file registry

summary.zh: 这一版把外部工具接入（MCP 连接器）从「插件里的一个功能」升级成正式能力：支持新版协议免握手直连，工具需要补充信息时会弹出表单让你填而不是直接失败；每个连接器可以单独设定「每次都问」还是「只问没授权过的」；连接器太多时不再把几十份工具说明全塞进模型上下文，改成可搜索的目录按需取用。连接器设置页重做成列表加详情，批量导入先预览再写入，批准工具时可以只记住这一个工具。浏览器会话不再动不动被销毁：关掉最后一个标签页留一个空工作区，卡片上的 X 只是收起，切换会话时浏览器跟着走。另外修好了大上下文模型几乎永远轮不到自动压缩、缓存指纹漂移把整轮请求打挂、工作流报告「超时」却还在后台跑几个小时这几个问题。置顶会话现在可以拖拽排序。
summary.en: This release promotes external tool connectors (MCP) from a feature inside a plugin into a first-class capability. It speaks the new handshake-free protocol revision, and a tool that needs more information now opens a form for you to fill in instead of just failing. Each connector can be set to ask every time or only for tools you have not allowed. When you have many connectors, their tool schemas no longer all sit in the model's context; they are reached through a searchable catalog instead. The connector settings page is rebuilt as a list and a detail page, JSON import previews before it writes, and approving a tool can now be remembered for that one tool alone. Browser sessions stop being destroyed by accident: closing the last tab leaves an empty workspace, the card's X only collapses it, and the viewer follows you when you switch sessions. Also fixed: large-context models almost never reaching auto-compaction, a cache fingerprint drift failing the whole turn, and workflows reporting a timeout while still running for hours. Pinned sessions can now be dragged into any order you like.

title.zh: 支持新版连接器协议，工具可以中途问你要信息
title.en: New connector protocol, and tools that can ask you for input

summary.zh: 远程连接器现在会先探一次对方支持哪个协议版本：支持新版的免握手直连，探测失败或对方是旧版就退回原来的握手流程。更实用的变化是，工具调用到一半需要补充信息时（比如缺一个参数、要你选一项），会在确认卡片上直接长出一个表单让你填，填完原样继续；以前这种调用会直接失败。
summary.en: A remote connector now probes which protocol revision the server speaks: new-revision servers are addressed directly with no handshake, and anything ambiguous or older falls back to the original handshake. The change you will actually notice is that a tool call needing more information mid-flight — a missing field, a choice to make — now grows a small form on the confirmation card and resumes once you fill it in. Such calls previously just failed.

details.zh: 表单支持文本、数字、勾选、枚举选项和一层嵌套字段，必填项留空会拦住提交并说明原因；遇到渲染不了的字段类型会点名说清楚，而不是发一份填了一半的答案回去。
details.en: The form handles text, numbers, checkboxes, enumerated choices and one level of nested fields; a blank required field blocks submission and says why, and a field type it cannot render is named outright rather than sent back half-answered.

details.zh: 拒绝、超时、中断都是明确结果：调用会带上连接器名和原因失败，不会背着你重试。同一次调用最多问三轮，避免服务端反复提问却永远不结束。
details.en: Declining, timing out and aborting are all explicit outcomes: the call fails naming the connector and the reason, and never retries behind your back. Three rounds is the ceiling, so a server that keeps asking without finishing is stopped.

details.zh: 服务器反过来向我们发起的请求（采样、目录列举等我们没实现的），现在会明确回一句「不支持这个方法」。以前是静默丢弃，对方会一直等一个永远不来的回复。
details.en: A request the server initiates toward us — sampling, roots listing, anything we do not implement — is now answered with an explicit "method not found". It used to be silently discarded, leaving the server blocked on a reply that never came.

details.zh: 连接器现在会记录服务端声明的工具列表保鲜期，先存下来备用；暂时还没有任何逻辑依赖它自动刷新。
details.en: Connectors now record the tool-list freshness hint a server advertises. It is recorded only; nothing polls or expires on it yet.

title.zh: 每个连接器可以单独设定要问多严
title.en: Each connector carries its own review policy

summary.zh: 以前所有外部工具一律每次都弹确认。现在每个连接器可以选「每次都问」（默认，行为不变）或「只问没授权过的」，还能逐个工具指定放行或复审，另有一个可选开关：信任服务端自己标记为「只读」的工具。
summary.en: Every external tool used to prompt for confirmation on every call. Each connector can now be set to review everything (the default, unchanged) or to an allowlist, with per-tool allow/review overrides and an optional switch that trusts tools the server itself marks read-only.

details.zh: 服务端声明为「破坏性」的工具永远不会被静默放行，哪怕你把它加进了白名单。
details.en: A tool the server declares destructive is never silently approved, even when you have explicitly allowed it.

details.zh: 「信任只读」只在服务器当次运行真的声明了只读标记时才生效。这些标记只存在内存里，重启后重新采集，所以一份过期的标记没法给一个已经不再只读的工具背书。
details.en: Trusting read-only tools applies only when the running server actually declared the hint. Those declarations live in memory and are re-collected on each start, so a stale hint cannot vouch for a tool that is no longer read-only.

details.zh: 批准时可以只授权「本次会话剩下的时间」。这种授权不落盘，重启后会重新问你。
details.en: An approval can be granted for the rest of the current session only. Such a grant is never written to disk and you are asked again after a restart.

details.zh: 在这些字段出现之前保存的连接器，读出来就是上面这套安全默认值，不需要你重新配置。
details.en: Connectors saved before these fields existed read out as the safe defaults above, so nothing needs reconfiguring.

title.zh: 连接器工具太多时改成目录按需取用
title.en: Many connector tools now load on demand

summary.zh: 接了几个连接器之后，几十上百份工具说明会全部塞进模型的上下文，既占地方又拖慢每一轮。现在超过阈值（默认 10 个）时，这些工具的完整说明不再进入上下文，模型改用搜索、查看详情、调用这三个入口按需取用。低于阈值时行为完全不变，内置工具默认也不参与。
summary.en: With a few connectors attached, dozens of tool schemas all sat in the model's context, taking up room and slowing every turn. Past a threshold (10 by default) those schemas no longer enter the context; the model reaches them through search, describe and call instead. At or below the threshold nothing changes, and builtin tools stay out of this by default.

details.zh: 会话开头会收到一份可用工具清单，模型知道有哪些能力可以找，不用盲搜。清单每个会话只发一次，休眠唤醒和分叉都不会重发。
details.en: A session opens with the listing of what it can reach, so the model is not searching blind. The listing is delivered once per session and is not repeated after hibernation or a fork.

details.zh: 工具目录变化时（比如某个连接器刷新后多了或少了工具），会用一句简短通知告知，而不是把整份清单重发一遍。
details.en: When the catalog changes shape — a connector refresh adds or drops tools — a short notice says so rather than restating the whole listing.

details.zh: 搜索排序不看工具来自哪个连接器，两个同样匹配的工具不会因为出身而分高下。
details.en: Search ranking deliberately ignores which connector a tool came from, so two equally matching tools score identically.

details.zh: 可以把指定工具钉住，让它即使在延迟模式下也始终留在上下文里；阈值和总开关在连接器设置页里可调。
details.en: Named tools can be pinned so they stay in context even when their connector defers; the threshold and the switch are both adjustable in connector settings.

title.zh: 连接器设置页重做，批准工具可以只记住这一个
title.en: Connector settings rebuilt, and approvals you can scope to one tool

summary.zh: 连接器设置从一整页平铺改成「列表 + 每个连接器一页详情」。列表行直接显示状态灯、工具数、有几个 Agent 开着它，以及运行时真正记下的错误原因（以前只写一个「失败」）。详情页把连接方式、工具、本 Agent 是否可用、审批严格程度分成四块。批准工具时，除了原来的「本次对话都别再问」，现在还能选「这一个工具本次对话别再问」和「以后都允许这一个工具」。
summary.en: Connector settings goes from one flat page to a list that opens into a page per connector. Rows show a status light, the tool count, how many agents have it on, and — new — the error the runtime actually recorded, where a failed connector used to read only "failed". The detail page splits into how it connects, its tools, whether this agent may use it, and how much review its calls need. When approving a tool, alongside the existing "stop asking for this whole conversation" you can now stop asking about just this one tool, or allow just this one tool from now on.

details.zh: 工具可搜索、可批量选择，全选／反选／全不选作用于当前搜索结果并一次请求提交。以前四十个工具意味着四十次请求。
details.en: Tools are searchable and selectable in bulk; select all / none / invert act on what the search shows and submit as one request. Forty tools used to mean forty requests.

details.zh: JSON 批量导入改成「解析 → 预览 → 确认」，可以剔除不要的条目，整批作为一次事务写入。以前是逐个发请求，第四条写错就留下三个已添加的连接器且无从分辨。
details.en: JSON import is now parse, preview, confirm: entries can be excluded and the rest are written as one transaction. It used to fire one request per server, so a typo in the fourth entry left three connectors added with no way to tell which.

details.zh: 延迟加载的工具在确认卡片上会显示真实的连接器名和工具名，而不是内部的转发工具名。查不到对应身份时退回普通批准按钮，不猜。
details.en: A deferred tool now names its real connector and tool on the confirmation card instead of the internal bridge name, and falls back to a plain approve button rather than guessing when it cannot be resolved.

details.zh: OAuth 授权等待改成带取消按钮的卡片，不再把整个设置页阻塞五分钟；取消后即使浏览器迟到回跳也不会把它重新变成已授权。
details.en: An OAuth wait is a card with a cancel button instead of a five-minute block on the whole tab, and a late browser redirect can no longer reopen a cancelled wait into a granted connection.

title.zh: 浏览器会话不再被误关，切换会话时跟着走
title.en: Browser sessions stop being closed by accident

summary.zh: 浏览器的关闭语义整体收紧了。聊天里那张浏览器卡片上的 X，以前会销毁整个浏览器并打断正在进行的工作，现在只是把卡片收起；侧边栏的浏览器徽标点一下是打开对应会话的浏览器，真正的关闭挪到徽标的右键菜单里。关掉最后一个标签页也不再销毁整个浏览器，而是留一个空的工作区。
summary.en: Closing semantics are tightened throughout. The X on the browser card in chat used to destroy the whole browser and interrupt work in progress; it now only collapses the card. Clicking the sidebar browser badge opens that session's viewer, and actually closing moves into the badge's context menu. Closing the last tab no longer destroys the browser either — it leaves an empty workspace behind.

details.zh: 切换会话时浏览器视图不再直接隐藏：保持打开并切到目标会话的标签组（没有就显示空状态），工具栏上标出当前是哪个会话。
details.en: Switching sessions no longer hides the viewer: it stays open and shows the target session's tab group (or an empty state), with the session title in the toolbar.

details.zh: 新增紧急停止：可以按会话撤销 Agent 的浏览器使用授权，下一条新消息发出后授权自动恢复。
details.en: An emergency stop revokes the agent's browser authorization for that session; sending a new message lifts the revocation.

details.zh: 同时满足「Agent 没在用」和「你没在看」的浏览器会话，30 分钟后冷挂起回收，占用的资源交还系统。
details.en: A browser session idle on both counts — the agent is not using it and you are not watching it — is cold-suspended after 30 minutes to give its resources back.

title.zh: 大上下文模型终于能正常触发自动压缩了
title.en: Auto-compaction now actually triggers on large-context models

summary.zh: 自动压缩的触发线原本是「离上限还剩固定 16384 token」，这个数放在百万级上下文的模型上等于 98% 才触发，会话往往还没压缩就已经撑爆。现在改成按窗口比例算：窗口的 10% 与 16384 取大者，换模型时触发线自动跟着变。
summary.en: Auto-compaction used to trigger at a fixed 16384 tokens from the ceiling. On a model with a million-token window that sits above 98% of the window, so sessions overflowed before they ever compacted. The reserve is now proportional — the larger of 16384 and 10% of the window — and moves with the model when you switch.

details.zh: 以前只在一整轮工具调用全部结束后才检查一次，一个长工具循环可以毫无检查地跑过上限。现在轮次进行中也会检查并压缩。
details.en: The threshold used to be checked only after a whole agentic run ended, so one long tool loop could run past the window unchecked. Compaction can now happen mid-run.

details.zh: 轮次中途压缩后会追加一条提示，让模型知道自己被打断过、该接着摘要里没做完的部分继续，而不是重做或反过来问你要确认。
details.en: After a mid-run compaction a notice is appended so the model knows it was interrupted and should resume the summary's remaining work instead of redoing it or asking you to confirm.

sources.title: feat(compaction): proportional auto-compaction threshold and mid-turn compaction

title.zh: 缓存指纹对不上不再把整轮请求打挂
title.en: A cache fingerprint mismatch no longer fails your turn

summary.zh: 内部有一份缓存前缀的指纹校验，用来确认系统提示词和工具表没被人改过又忘了重新签。对不上其实只意味着少命中一次供应商缓存，答案本身没有任何问题，但以前它会直接抛错，让你为一次内部漏签付出一轮失败的代价。现在改成记录并自动续签，请求照常放行。
summary.en: An internal fingerprint checks that the system prompt and tool table were not rebuilt without re-signing. A mismatch only costs a provider cache hit; nothing about the answer becomes wrong. It used to be thrown as an error, making you pay for our missing renewal with a failed turn. Drift is now recorded, the contract renews itself, and the request goes through.

details.zh: 漂移记录会写清第一处差异的位置和两边各 120 字的片段，以及新增／删除／变更的工具名，方便定位是哪次改动漏了续签。日志和事件只带哈希与元数据，不会带上完整提示词。
details.en: The drift record carries the first differing position with a 120-character excerpt from each side, plus the tool names added, removed or changed. Logs and emitted events still carry only hashes and metadata, never the whole prompt.

sources.title: feat(cache): record and auto-renew on cache prefix drift instead of failing the request

title.zh: 工作流：节点写权限要自己申报，失败会重试，超时是真的停
title.en: Workflows: declared write scope, real retries, and honest timeouts

summary.zh: 工作流的资源与权限模型重做了。能写文件的节点现在必须自己申报要写哪些目录，不再默认继承整个会话的写权限，没申报会在调用时被拦住并给出改法。运行时长从一条 10 分钟的总死线，换成三层：单节点超时、10 分钟无进展看门狗、4 小时总兜底，长批量任务不会再在 10 分钟处被误杀。
summary.en: The workflow resource and permission model is rebuilt. A node that can write files must now declare which folders it writes, instead of inheriting the whole session's write scope by default; a node that does not declare is rejected at call time with guidance on how to fix it. The single ten-minute deadline becomes three layers — a per-node timeout, a ten-minute no-progress watchdog and a four-hour total backstop — so legitimate long batch runs are no longer killed at the ten-minute mark.

details.zh: 节点级重试：暂时性失败退避 5 秒、20 秒后重试（默认两次），校验错误、权限拒绝、预算耗尽这类确定性失败不重试。挂住的节点会被单独掐掉重试，而不是拖死整个运行。
details.en: Nodes retry on transient failures with a 5s then 20s backoff (twice by default), while deterministic failures — validation, scope, budget, abort — are never retried. A hung node is killed and retried on its own instead of dragging down the whole run.

details.zh: 并发上限从 256 降到 16，扇出不再一头撞进供应商的限流。五个参数（节点超时、空闲、总时长、并发、重试）都能按次调用覆盖。
details.en: Concurrency drops from 256 to 16 so a fan-out stops slamming into provider rate limits. All five knobs — node timeout, idle, total, concurrency, retries — are overridable per call.

details.zh: 失败消息带上运行 id 和续跑提示，重新派发时已完成的节点直接读缓存，不用从头再跑一遍。
details.en: Failure messages carry the run id and a resume hint, so a re-dispatch replays completed nodes from cache instead of starting over.

details.zh: 运行日志里的失败条目现在写明失败原因和尝试次数，事后能查清一次扇出到底是哪一步崩的。
details.en: Journal error entries now record why a node failed and how many attempts it took, which makes post-mortem attribution of a fan-out possible.

title.zh: 中断隔离运行时真的会停下来
title.en: Aborting an isolated run actually stops it

summary.zh: 子代理、工作流节点、自动化任务都跑在隔离会话里。中断信号只在信号到达的那一瞬间发一次，而隔离会话在进入主循环前有一段异步准备时间，落在这段窗口里的中断会被吞掉，任务照常跑完。现在中断请求会一直挂着，等到第一个事件证明运行真的开始了再补发一次。
summary.en: Subagents, workflow nodes and automation all run in isolated sessions. The abort was delivered once, at signal time, but an isolated session does asynchronous preparation before it enters its agent loop — an abort landing in that window was swallowed and the run finished regardless. The abort request is now sticky and re-delivered as soon as the first event proves the run is active.

details.zh: 已经正常跑完的运行不会因为紧随其后到达的中断而丢掉结果。
details.en: A run that finished normally keeps its result even when an abort arrives right afterwards.

details.zh: 被中断的运行统一报 aborted，调用方只需要认这一种说法。
details.en: Aborted runs converge on a single "aborted" error, so callers only have to recognize one word.

sources.title: fix(core): executeIsolated honors mid-run abort

title.zh: 置顶会话可以拖拽排序
title.en: Drag to reorder pinned sessions

summary.zh: 置顶区以前按最近消息时间排，一说话顺序就变。现在是你手动固定的顺序：拖动置顶行时按指针落在目标行上半还是下半显示插入线，松手立即重排，失败整体回滚并提示。新置顶的会话插到最前面。
summary.en: The pinned area used to sort by most recent message, so the order shifted whenever you said something. It is now the order you set: dragging a pinned row shows an insertion line above or below the target depending on where the pointer sits, and drops commit immediately, rolling back as a whole if the write fails. Newly pinned sessions go to the top.

details.zh: 置顶行拖出置顶区（拖到项目、文件夹或根）不做任何事；普通行拖进项目的原有语义不变。
details.en: Dragging a pinned row out of the pinned area — into a project, a folder or the root — does nothing, and dragging ordinary rows into a project behaves as before.

details.zh: 顺序在桌面端和移动端 PWA 之间同步。
details.en: The order syncs between desktop and the mobile PWA.

details.zh: 取消置顶会清掉它的顺序，重新置顶按新置顶处理，回到最前面。
details.en: Unpinning clears a session's order; pinning it again counts as a fresh pin and puts it back at the top.

feat(sessions): persist manual pin order for pinned sessions

title.zh: 升级时为已有置顶会话固化当前顺序
title.en: Upgrade freezes the current order of existing pins

summary.zh: 升级会给会话清单数据库补一个可空的顺序列（幂等，不重建表），并在第一次列出会话时，把已经置顶但还没有顺序的会话按你此刻看到的顺序（最近活动优先）一次性固化下来。所以升级前后置顶区的显示顺序是一样的，之后才由你自己拖。
summary.en: The upgrade adds a nullable order column to the session manifest database (idempotent, no table rebuild) and, the first time sessions are listed, freezes the order you currently see — most recent activity first — for pins that do not have one yet. The pinned area therefore looks identical across the upgrade, and diverges only once you start dragging.

details.zh: 固化完成会记账，写失败则下次列出会话时重试，不会留下半套顺序。
details.en: Completion is recorded; a failed write is retried the next time sessions are listed, so no half-applied ordering is left behind.

sources.title: feat(sessions): persist manual pin order for pinned sessions

title.zh: 其它修复
title.en: Other fixes

summary.zh: 这一版还修好了媒体生成指南在更新后失效、侧边栏行高闪回默认值、Kimi K3 图片输入被误判为不支持，以及更新检查在两个来源都失败时过早放弃这几个问题。
summary.en: This release also fixes the media generation guide breaking after an update, the sidebar row height flashing back to its default, Kimi K3 being wrongly advertised as text-only, and the update check giving up too early when both sources failed.

details.zh: 媒体生成指南以前是内置插件里的一个技能文件，路径被冻进会话提示词，而这个目录每次服务端更新都会整个替换掉，更新后模型读到的是一个已删除的路径，读不到内容就直接开始生成。现在指南由工具直接返回，路径失效的坑不复存在。
details.en: The media generation guide used to be a skill file inside the versioned server directory, whose absolute path was frozen into each session's prompt while that directory is replaced wholesale on every update. The model read a deleted path, got nothing, and generated media without the guide. The guide is now returned by a tool, so the path can no longer go stale.

details.zh: 侧边栏的行高和折叠状态以前存在组件里，侧栏每次重挂载（包括悬浮侧栏每次 hover）都会先按默认的双行渲染再跳回你的设置，前端一忙就肉眼可见。现在这些偏好归属应用状态，首帧就是对的。
details.en: Sidebar row height and collapsed folders used to live in component state, so every remount — including each hover of the floating sidebar — rendered the two-line default before snapping back to your setting, which was visible whenever the front end was busy. Those preferences now live in application state and the first frame is already correct.

details.zh: Kimi Coding K3 之前被标成纯文本模型，无法发图；k3-256k 也没用上它文档标注的 256K 上下文。两项都已修正。
details.en: Kimi Coding K3 was marked text-only so images could not be attached, and k3-256k fell back to generic metadata instead of its documented 256K context. Both are corrected.

details.zh: 检查更新时会同时问镜像和源站，源站那一路限时 8 秒以免拖慢镜像已经答上的情况。但镜像也失败时这个前提就不成立了，以前整轮直接失败。现在会给源站一次不限速的完整重试。
details.en: The update check races the mirror against the origin, capping the origin at 8 seconds so it can never delay a round the mirror already answered. When the mirror fails too that premise is gone, yet the round used to fail outright. The origin now gets one final full-budget attempt.

fix(sidebar): keep session list row mode stable across sidebar remounts
